vision.name: Bojack
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use at the end of combat. Destroy an Ally or Setup you control to Rejuvenate 4.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
You may destroy a Named Ally or Named Setup you control. If you do, damage from this attack cannot be prevented.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
